public_rationale: Marcus forecast that AGI would not arrive in 2025, against Musk's prediction of AI smarter than any human by the end of 2025. An independent year-end review judged Musk's forecast mostly false. Mid-2025 reporting said GPT-5 was nowhere near true AGI. In January 2026, Musk himself still put AI smarter than any human in the future. No AI system was widely accepted as AGI during 2025.
limitations: AGI is loosely defined, so the result rests on broad acceptance rather than a formal test.
Some executives made AGI claims in 2026 (for example, Nvidia's CEO in March 2026), but these fall after the horizon and use loose definitions.

our_interpretation: Plain reading: by 31 December 2025 no AI system was broadly accepted by independent observers as AGI, meaning broadly human-level general competence or Musk's bar of 'smarter than any one human'.
A self-declared AGI under a company's own or financial definition does not count unless widely accepted.
Statements made after 2025 are context only.
criteria.support_condition: Independent reviews of 2025 find no system reached AGI or Musk's bar by end of 2025.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Credible evidence that during 2025 an AI system was widely accepted as AGI or as smarter than any single human.
